summary: Operational failure episodes are folded again only when an operational failure or recovery claim was added or trimmed, not on every lookup of one episode

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change; the key is read from claims_kind_index.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests unchanged; a trim lowers the count, so the next lookup folds the claims that remain.

compatibility.detail: The same episodes, statuses and order.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build restores the fold on every lookup; the episodes are kept in memory only.
